node.title: ④ MASTER THE PRACTICE — How to Build Your Ongoing Discipline
node.body:
Why Your Ongoing Practice Matters

Your learning doesn’t end at the completion of a stage. The real understanding develops through repetition — watching how the concepts you’ve studied show up in the live experiment, week after week. These habits create the structure that helps every lesson “stick,” no matter whether you’re in Copilot, Captain, or Ace.

Your Weekly and Daily Habits

EVERY SUNDAY | Log in to the TrendMonster dashboard and check whether the allocation model has updated. Take a moment to review what changed and reflect on why it shifted, using the concepts from your current learning stage.

DAILY | Watch the Student Questions updates. This keeps you connected to the ongoing experiment and helps you see how the ideas from your lessons play out in real market conditions.

WEEKLY | Join the Q&A session for your current level. These sessions are designed to help you apply what you’re learning and clarify anything that feels unclear.
Once you’ve reached the Captain stage, also attend the mid-week strategy update to deepen your understanding of what the model is observing in real time.

ALWAYS | Ask questions. The Student Questions and Q&A sessions exist so you can learn openly and confidently. Every question strengthens your understanding — and the sooner you ask, the faster you progress.

How This Practice Supports Your Progress

These habits guide you steadily through each stage. As you move from Copilot to Captain to Ace, the same routines provide deeper insight each time. The more consistently you engage with the dashboard, updates, and discussions, the more natural it becomes to interpret what the model is showing you.

node.title: Workbook
I’ve been keeping a secret from you...
node.body:
Hi,

I teach you a lot of strategies in the Mentorship. But for the last few months, I’ve been quietly working on something else in the background.

I wanted to answer one question: "Is it possible to catch the massive bull runs (like 2020-2021) but completely step aside before the crashes (like 2022)?"

To answer it, I teamed up with our Head Coach, Elliott. Elliott isn't just a coach; he’s a former Market Maker. He built a logic engine that tracks the "Fear" in the market.

  • When the market is calm, it gives us a GREEN signal (We ride the trend).

  • When the market is stressed, it gives us a RED signal (We go to Cash).

The Experiment: I am so confident in this logic that I have funded a personal account with $1,000,000 of my own cash to trade it live.

I call it TrendMonster.

Normally, access to this dashboard is $499/month. But because you are my student, I want you to have the first look.

node.title: Quick notes for 14 Oct 2025
node.body:
Quick update: 

To call this market action "whippy" and "volatile" is a huge understatement! The past three days clearly show the intensity we're facing. 

On Friday, the Dow dropped close to 900 points, then yesterday it surged nearly 600 points, and today it added over 200 more. 

Looking at the intraday movement, the hour-by-hour swings are astonishing—down over 600 points early on, followed by a sharp "U-turn" that erased the loss and pushed gains past 450 points before weakening again, ending with a 203-point rise. 

This erratic behavior reinforces our ongoing thesis. It highlights why we emphasize not fixating on wild index swings, instead focusing more on industry trends. 

Our Diversified Metals and Uranium picks, as well as Solar recommendations, are still performing well, with some continuing to rocket higher. 

Meanwhile, as expected, most "Magnificent 7" stocks are underperforming, and Semiconductor issues, though bullish long-term, are now dragging short-term. 

This market truly reflects "good is good, and bad is bad," aligning with our industry  strategy!

node.title: [ESSENTIAL] Start Trading
node.body:
You have made it through almost the entire course! Well done!! Your perseverance means you will succeed.

It is time to take your paper trading game to the next level. Reset your paper trading account, and select an amount that you actually want to trade with when you start with real money.

Say it is $20,000. Now set up paper trades within that budget.

Take it really seriously. Imagine this is your hard earned money.


 

I hope that you will have some big losses. Not because I am a sadist, but because you will learn from them. Share the losses with us on the Discord and ask for help. Make mistakes and learn to avoid them, so that when you start with your real money, you will know how to avoid these pitfalls.

Keep up paper trading for the following 30 days.

Track your trades using my spreadsheet. Just make a copy of it and add your trades:

Have fun!
